summary.text: Jason Hoskins is a Democratic state representative from Michigan's District 18, serving since 2023, who is the Democratic candidate for Michigan State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney and former legislative director to state Senator Jeremy Moss, he is not seeking re-election to the House.

paragraphs.text: Jason Hoskins earned a B.S. in political science and government from Eastern Michigan University in 2007, an M.P.A. from Eastern Michigan University in 2010, and a J.D. from the University of Detroit Mercy in 2013.

His career experience includes working as an attorney, as legislative director in the office of Michigan state Senator Jeremy Moss, as an adjunct professor with Lawrence Technological University, and as a campaign staffer on Mark Totten's 2014 attorney general campaign.
Hoskins took office in the Michigan House of Representatives for District 18 on January 1, 2023, succeeding Kevin Hertel.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for State Senate District 7 on August 4, 2026.
